release_ref_policy: the release pointer must reference a main commit that passed the M9 gate; if a Git tag is later created it must point to the same gated commit and must not redefine semantics

python_distribution.name: factorlab-trend-reversion-regime-lab
python_distribution.reason: the repository distribution contains historical research and maintenance modules outside the stable trend component surface

patch_release: internal refactor that preserves public schemas fields and lifecycle behavior
minor_release: additive caller capability that preserves the existing query contract
additive provider/profile admission only with a new exact source admission receipt and unchanged existing behavior
additive optional metadata only when older V1 callers can ignore it safely
major_release_required: change to state enum or T1 directional boundaries
change to estimator or directional_score definition
change to required query arguments or meaning
change to immutable snapshot identity or expiry/no-fallback semantics
introduction of formal T2 or STRONG_UP/STRONG_DOWN product states
introduction of Layer2 global_state strategy selection routing or trading action
change from production_authority=false without independent governance
compatibility_policy.schema_rule: a semantic change must receive a new schema/version identity; historical V1 snapshots are never rewritten

from_pre_m7_internal_usage: replace direct internal measurement reads with TrendRegimeConsumer.query_regime
treat UNAVAILABLE as missing state rather than SIDEWAYS
do not fall back after latest expiry or latest explicit unavailable
do not pass lookback estimator T1 T2 validity policy or strategy action into the consumer
migration_policy.five_bucket_research_artifacts: not a prior stable product API and therefore not a V1 migration source; retain only for historical research audit
migration_policy.future_breaking_change: publish a new major component version and migration note; never silently mutate V1

evidence_lineage.role: interval/profile and causal Layer1 view binding
empirical closeout and source admission evidence
stable consumer snapshot lifecycle and provider admission
release compatibility migration lineage and governance

known_limitations: 15m 60m and phase profiles are not admitted in the current V1 runtime registry
M5 empirical strength evidence is limited to admitted 1m and 5m views on CSI1000 and STAR50
STAR50 has a real parallel risk-state provider but no proven connected external strategy caller
M8 validates interface and ownership boundaries but not live deployment
2025 protocol Holdout was not opened and fresh_oos remains false
Layer2 does not own a complete trading-calendar authority beyond admitted provider receipts
this release grants no BUY SELL position order routing strategy-selection or production authority

required: default M2 through M8 tests plus M9 release-governance invariants pass
M6 M7 M8 frozen semantics remain unchanged
M5 validation sensitivity replication jobs remain disabled or skipped
historical full-replay jobs remain opt-in and are not triggered by release finalization
release notes disclose non-production and limited runtime admission
forbidden: expand runtime admission without a new exact source receipt
map state or strength directly to a trading action
